base.scope: Placement candidate only, not route or physical qualification

scope: Candidate physical placement only; no electrical, routing or timing acceptance. Reserved halos are empty placement space, not changes to frozen native masks.

electrical_refinement.capacity_proxy: 2*wire_bbox_sum_um/die_area_um2; placement objective only, not a routability proof
electrical_refinement.scope: Actual native pin/driver budgets with explicitly recorded rigid placement clusters. Cluster rectangles reserve empty space only; individual original masks, all active instances and their actual RC remain mandatory.
electrical_refinement.search_budget: Driver maximum minus actual native ground and minimum actual input pin capacitance; necessary bound only. Detours/vias/coupling and complete RC acceptance still required.
